runtimeInstanceId: separate lowercase 12-hex namespace, never an API UUID

sourceBinding.bootstrap: current module and contract SHA256, independently pinned by installer

hba.initial: local postgres peer; local named installation roles SCRAM; reject all TCP
hba.bound: login from exact owned proxy IP/32; migration/service from exact observed owned writer IP/32; no other TCP grants
hba.configuration: written only inside exact owned PGDATA volume; no extra PostgreSQL mounts or exported socket
hba.adminTransport: trusted Docker exec --user postgres and local peer; never secret argv

invariants: Only newly created dedicated owned resources with private creation receipt; never adopt a foreign or unknown cluster.
Exact container/image/volume/network identities, ownership labels, no PG host publication and PG16 metadata checked before writes.
Migration owner, service DML account and frontend restricted login stay distinct.
Prepare before actual247 migration; explicit SPRING_FLYWAY_USER/PASSWORD and DATABASE_USERNAME/PASSWORD are verified on actual artifact.
Service defaults may grant application DML; frontend receives only existing explicit169 policy, never wildcard future security grants.
Private owner-only durable phase receipt excludes credentials/verifiers; ambiguous partial state remains blocked with ingress closed.
No host installation, existing runtime reuse, API UUID invention, migration/product edits, automatic foreign cleanup or fencing-readiness claim.
writerBindings: one explicit {containerId,imageId,address,role} per allowed migration/service role; serviceSources remains {role,address}
storage: new local volume without driver options; dedicated internal bridge network; no adoption/bind-driver indirection
